# Example: UI User Story

**Generated by**: `/story` skill  
**Context**: Frontend UI story for a new feature

---

## Title
User Profile Settings Page - Edit Profile

## User Story
**As a** registered user  
**I want** to edit my profile information  
**So that** I can keep my account details up to date

## Background
Users need the ability to update their profile information including name, email, phone number, and profile picture. This page provides a user-friendly interface for managing personal information with proper validation and error handling.

## Personas
- End User (primary user editing their own profile)
- Account Administrator (may edit user profiles in admin panel)

## Dependencies & Assumptions

| Dependency | Type | Notes |
|------------|------|-------|
| User API endpoints | Backend | GET/PUT /api/users/{id} must exist |
| Authentication | Security | User must be logged in |
| Image upload service | Backend | For profile picture uploads |
| Form validation library | Frontend | Use existing project validation |
| Design system | UI | Use project design system components |

## UI/UX Design

### Wireframe Reference
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Profile Settings                       │
│  ─────────────────                      │
│                                         │
│  [Profile Picture]  [Change Photo]      │
│                                         │
│  Name:              [John Doe________]  │
│  Email:             [john@example.com_] │
│  Phone:             [(555) 123-4567__]  │
│  Bio:               [______________    │
│                      ______________    │
│                      ______________]   │
│                                         │
│  [Cancel]              [Save Changes]   │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### UI Components
- Form container with max-width for readability
- Avatar/Profile picture display with upload button
- Text input fields with labels
- Textarea for bio (200 character limit)
- Primary action button (Save Changes)
- Secondary action button (Cancel)
- Inline validation messages
- Success/error toast notifications

## Acceptance Criteria

### AC 1: Page Load - Display Current Profile
```gherkin
Given I am logged in as a user
When I navigate to /settings/profile
Then page displays my current profile information
And Name field shows my current name
And Email field shows my current email
And Phone field shows my current phone
And Bio field shows my current bio
And Profile picture shows my current avatar or default
And all fields are editable
```

### AC 2: Edit Name - Valid Input
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I change the Name field to "Jane Smith"
And I click "Save Changes"
Then API sends PUT /api/users/{id} with updated name
And success message displays "Profile updated successfully"
And Name field shows "Jane Smith"
And changes persist after page refresh
```

### AC 3: Edit Email - Valid Format
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I change Email field to "jane.smith@example.com"
And I click "Save Changes"
Then inline validation shows email format is valid
And API sends PUT /api/users/{id} with updated email
And success message displays "Profile updated successfully"
And Email field shows "jane.smith@example.com"
```

### AC 4: Edit Email - Invalid Format
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I change Email field to "invalid-email"
And I click "Save Changes"
Then inline error message displays "Please enter a valid email address"
And field border turns red
And API is NOT called
And form does not submit
```

### AC 5: Edit Phone - Valid Format
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I change Phone field to "(555) 987-6543"
And I click "Save Changes"
Then phone number is formatted automatically as I type
And API sends PUT /api/users/{id} with updated phone
And success message displays "Profile updated successfully"
```

### AC 6: Upload Profile Picture - Success
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I click "Change Photo"
And I select a valid image file (JPG, PNG) under 5MB
Then image preview displays immediately
When I click "Save Changes"
Then API uploads image to /api/users/{id}/avatar
And profile picture updates to new image
And success message displays "Profile picture updated"
```

### AC 7: Upload Profile Picture - Invalid File
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I click "Change Photo"
And I select an invalid file (e.g., .pdf, .txt) or file over 5MB
Then error message displays "Please upload a JPG or PNG image under 5MB"
And file is not uploaded
And current profile picture remains unchanged
```

### AC 8: Cancel Changes
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
And I have made changes to Name, Email, or Phone
When I click "Cancel"
Then confirmation dialog displays "Discard unsaved changes?"
When I click "Discard"
Then all fields revert to original values
And no API calls are made
And form is reset
```

### AC 9: Form Validation - Empty Required Fields
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I clear the Name field (required)
And I click "Save Changes"
Then inline error displays "Name is required"
And "Save Changes" button is disabled
And form does not submit
```

### AC 10: API Error Handling
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I make valid changes and click "Save Changes"
And API returns 500 Internal Server Error
Then error message displays "Failed to update profile. Please try again."
And form remains editable
And changes are not lost
And user can retry save
```

### AC 11: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page
When I use Tab key to navigate
Then focus moves through fields in logical order:
  1. Name field
  2. Email field
  3. Phone field
  4. Bio field
  5. Change Photo button
  6. Cancel button
  7. Save Changes button
And focus indicators are clearly visible
And I can submit form using Enter key
```

### AC 12: Accessibility - Screen Reader Support
```gherkin
Given I am using a screen reader
When I navigate to profile settings page
Then screen reader announces "Profile Settings, Form"
And each field has clear label association
And error messages are announced when validation fails
And success messages are announced after save
```

### AC 13: Responsive Design - Mobile View
```gherkin
Given I am on the profile settings page on mobile device (width < 768px)
Then form layout stacks vertically
And profile picture is centered
And buttons stack vertically (Cancel on top, Save on bottom)
And all fields remain accessible
And form is usable without horizontal scrolling
```

## Technical Implementation Notes

### Frontend Technology
- Framework: Use project's frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular, Vue)
- State management: Use project's state management solution
- Validation: Use project's form validation library
- HTTP client: Use project's API client

### Validation Rules
- **Name**: Required, 2-50 characters, letters and spaces only
- **Email**: Required, valid email format
- **Phone**: Optional, US format (###) ###-#### auto-formatted
- **Bio**: Optional, max 200 characters, show character count
- **Profile Picture**: JPG/PNG, max 5MB, auto-crop to square

### Error Handling
- Show inline validation errors on blur
- Show API errors in toast notification
- Preserve form state on API error
- Provide retry option for failed saves

### Performance
- Debounce validation (300ms delay)
- Lazy load image upload component
- Show loading spinner during API calls
- Disable save button while submitting

### Security
- Validate all inputs client-side AND server-side
- Sanitize bio text to prevent XSS
- Use CSRF tokens for form submission
- Verify user can only edit their own profile

## Out of Scope
- Password change (separate form in different section)
- Account deletion (separate story)
- Email verification after email change (backend story)
- Privacy settings (separate story)
- Notification preferences (separate story)
